essence_and_facets.essence: A situated voice feels a precise system press against skin, teeth, breath, or ribs, then turns awe-laced indignation into one consequential permission the system must learn to obey.
facets: Embodied Authority — the body appears before the thesis, carries one unabstractable sensation, and changes what a useful system is permitted to do.
Distinct Causal Turn — each concept reaches a costly consequence beyond the generic claim that people exceed numbers.
Formal Irreversibility — one audible structural event transfers authority and cannot be removed without damaging the song's meaning.
Adoptable Dignity — the hook remains memorable and speakable without simplifying vulnerable lives, inventing testimony, or delivering generic uplift.
Pairwise Identity — title grammar, hook shape, section order, sonic device, factual pressure, and resolution remain collision-free across all six pairs.
